title: Blukon collector restart race condition
symptom: In some circumstances, xDrip restarts the collector even though it is communicating with Blukon, which can happen when 'Agressiv service restarts' is enabled or if the user forces a restart manually. This can lead to long reconnection times because xDrip waits 5 minutes each time.
cause: The collector restart logic does not check whether the Blukon device is actually communicating; it restarts based on missed reading service restarts, causing a race condition.
fix: Implement a static method `isCollecting()` in the Blukon class that returns true if data is being received, and use that to decide whether to restart the service instead of relying on `BgReading.last_within_millis()`. The method should be wired up to prevent restarts when communication is active.
evidence_quote: I think storing a timestamp of the last time blukon class received any data from the remote device and then we can use that (or a boolean method like `isCommunicating()` based on that timestamp to decide whether to restart the service instead of `BgReading.last_within_millis()` would make it more reliable.
